sections.title: How we work
sections.body: The same cleaner comes every visit and follows a checklist you can change any time. If something gets missed, tell us within a day and we come back to fix it.

items.author: Alicia Moreno
items.text: Same lady every week and the house smells amazing when we get home.

items.author: Grant Fowler
items.text: Booked a move-out clean and got our full deposit back.

items.author: Tasha Greene
items.text: Reliable, friendly and they never rush.

sections.headline: Get a price for your home
sections.body: Call or text with the number of bedrooms and bathrooms and we'll send a price the same day.
